clue.text: Representative of English supporter appearing in court

indicators.note: the English supporter shows up within the court, so those letters sit inside the other word

parts.note: to court someone is to date them
a leg supports the body or a table

explanation.surface: A delegate representing an English backer turns up at a court hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A delegate is a person sent to act or speak on behalf of others, a synonym for a representative.

clue.text: Celestial body's level of hydrogen lowered in core

indicators.note: the H for hydrogen at the top of the word is moved down to the bottom, as this is a down clue

parts.note: the heart of something is its core

explanation.surface: A planet whose inner layers hold a reduced proportion of hydrogen gas.
explanation.walkthrough: H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen; in a down entry, lowering it means sending it from the start to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is our planet, one of the bodies in the heavens studied by astronomers.

clue.text: Suppose soldiers had to discharge matter

parts.note: to expect something is to suppose it will be so
OR stands for Other Ranks, ordinary soldiers
had a meal means ate

explanation.surface: An officer assumes the troops were made to unload some cargo.
explanation.definitionFit: To expectorate is to cough up and spit out phlegm, a bodily discharge.

clue.text: Ecclesiastical denunciation of four articles suppressing Mass

indicators.note: the four articles sit on top of the Mass in this down entry, holding it down inside them

parts.note: AN, A, THE and A are four grammatical articles

explanation.surface: A church condemnation of four writings that sought to ban the Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: An anathema is a formal curse issued by the church, excommunicating someone.

clue.text: Constant figure in awkward relationship

parts.note: something constant never ends, it is eternal
a triangle is a geometric figure

explanation.surface: A person who keeps cutting a figure in an uncomfortable love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: An eternal triangle is the classic romantic tangle of three people, such as a couple and a lover.

clue.text: Distinction is extraordinary result

indicators.note: something extraordinary is out of the ordinary, so these letters are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Achieving distinction is a remarkable outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustre can mean glory or prestige, as when an honour adds lustre to a career.

clue.text: Poisonous lines filled with twisted hate

indicators.note: the two lines enclose the other letters, being filled up by them

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for line, doubled for lines

indicators.note: twisted out of shape signals the letters of hate are rearranged

explanation.surface: Venomous verses brimming with warped loathing.
explanation.definitionFit: A lethal substance can kill, as a poison does.

clue.text: Main statement of witness

definitions.note: the main is an old poetic term for the open sea

indicators.note: a statement is spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: to witness something is to see it

explanation.surface: The central testimony given by someone who saw an event.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is a literary word for the ocean, as in the Spanish Main.

clue.text: Teller reconciled current account initially containing nothing

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the zero inside them
reconciled accounts are rearranged to agree, so these letters are reordered
initially points to the first letter of account

parts.note: first letter of account
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A bank teller balanced the current account, which began with a zero balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Teller' suggests a bank clerk alongside the accounts language, but it means one who tells stories.
explanation.definitionFit: A raconteur is a skilled storyteller, someone who tells anecdotes well.

clue.text: Spirit doctor visited by artist each year

indicators.note: the artist comes into the doctor, so those letters go inside

parts.note: a GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts
PA is per annum, Latin for each year

explanation.surface: A painter calls on the family doctor every year for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Grappa is an Italian brandy distilled from grape residue, a kind of strong liquor.

clue.text: Means of accessing transport

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a door or way in
second meaning: to ..., enrapture or delight

explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' reads as vehicles, but here it is the verb meaning to carry away with delight, stressed on the second syllable.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a way in to a place; the verb, stressed differently, means to fill someone with wonder.

clue.text: American city losing its past elegance

indicators.note: the city loses part of its name, which is taken away

parts.note: Chicago is a big city in Illinois
ago means in the past

explanation.surface: A US city that has lost its former grace.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic as a noun means stylishness and sophistication.

clue.text: Stop America invading Chinese soil

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China

indicators.note: America pushes into the soil, so its letter goes inside

parts.note: ground is soil

explanation.surface: A call to halt American incursions into Chinese territory.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang around is to linger or stay, as in 'stop' meaning to remain somewhere a while.

clue.text: Missing monarch on the throne?

parts.note: on, in a down clue, means placed over
the throne is slang for the loo, the British word for toilet
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Where is the king? Perhaps he's on the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The throne' is a joke name for the toilet, so the monarch sitting there is the picture the pieces build, read top to bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlooking means failing to notice, passing over or leaving out.

clue.text: Unorthodox moral changes introduced by ill-conceived ban

indicators.note: the reworked ban comes first and leads in to the reworked moral
badly formed, so the letters of ban are put in a new order
the word moral changes form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shift in ethics brought in by a poorly thought-out prohibition.
explanation.definitionFit: Abnormal means departing from the usual, so it is unconventional or unorthodox.

clue.text: Counsel gentleman about entering trade negotiation

indicators.note: the reversed title goes into the bargaining word

parts.note: barter is trading by haggling over goods

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Sir is the title of a knight, a gentleman

explanation.surface: A gentleman advising on a commercial deal under discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel is the formal term for a barrister representing a client in court.

clue.text: Fair and square

definitions.meaning: second meaning: level, all debts settled

explanation.walkthrough: It looks like the phrase 'fair and square', but the two words each define the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Even describes an equal, just outcome and also being quits with nothing owed.

clue.text: Who is probably worse than King Richard and King Edward we hear?

definitions.text: Who is probably worse than King

indicators.note: the pieces are said aloud and the sound gives the spelling

parts.note: Dick is a familiar form of Richard, and a King Edward is a popular British potato variety, slang tater; together they sound like the answer

explanation.surface: Asking who could be more tyrannical than Richard III and the Edwards of English history.
explanation.walkthrough: The King Edward here is a potato, not a monarch; 'and' merely joins the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A dictator holds absolute unchecked power, usually seen as more tyrannical than a constitutional ruler.

clue.text: Territory in the Far East

indicators.note: the answer lies inside the phrase, spanning two of its words

parts.note: the letters run across far and East, ignoring the word break

explanation.surface: A region located in East Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: An area is a region or tract of land, a synonym for territory.

clue.text: Some of The Sun's output contains worse banter

indicators.note: the beam of light holds the comparative inside it

parts.note: a ray is a single beam of sunlight
iller means more unwell, worse

explanation.surface: Content in a tabloid newspaper features nastier jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is also a British tabloid, which makes 'output' look like journalism.
explanation.definitionFit: Raillery is good-humoured teasing or ridicule, much like banter.

clue.text: First part of play connected with fighting

parts.note: Act I is the opening section of a stage play
on means switched on, connected

explanation.surface: The opening scene of a drama has to do with combat.
explanation.definitionFit: Action is military combat, as in soldiers seeing action.

clue.text: Free from illusions and ethics, nihilism's beginning to develop

indicators.note: developing means changing and growing, so the letters are reformed
the beginning of nihilism is its first letter

parts.note: first letter of nihilism

explanation.surface: Breaking free of fantasies and morals, the first step towards believing in nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' looks like a link word but its letters belong in the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: To disenchant someone is to disillusion them, removing a false belief or spell.

clue.text: Get rid of unconscious inhibiting bias in the end

indicators.note: the knocked-out word holds back the letter by enclosing it

parts.note: out cold means unconscious

indicators.note: the end of bias is its final letter

parts.note: last letter of bias

explanation.surface: Eliminate subconscious prejudices that ultimately hold us back.
explanation.definitionFit: To oust is to drive out or remove from a position.

clue.text: Demonstrated method to open tin

indicators.note: the method goes between the letters, opening them up

parts.note: Sn is the chemical symbol for tin
how is the way or method

explanation.surface: Shown the technique for opening a can.
explanation.definitionFit: Shown is the past participle of show, meaning displayed or demonstrated.

clue.text: Permanent position in society

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it looks like one phrase about lasting status; split it after the first word.
explanation.definitionFit: A standing order is a fixed one, and one's standing is one's rank in the community.

clue.text: Constantly find fault with endless problems

indicators.note: without its ends, the word loses its first and last letters

parts.note: snags are problems or hitches

explanation.surface: Keep complaining about never-ending difficulties.
explanation.definitionFit: To nag is to keep criticising or pestering someone persistently.

clue.text: Personalise evening dress trimmed with gold

indicators.note: trimming cuts off the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: tails is a formal evening coat
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Customise a ball gown finished with gold edging.
explanation.definitionFit: To tailor something is to adapt it to an individual's needs, to customise it.

clue.text: Old outfit belonging to Dawn

parts.note: rig is clothing, an outfit
to be in something is to belong to it

explanation.surface: A vintage costume that was owned by a woman named Dawn.
explanation.walkthrough: Dawn looks like a name, but it is the beginning of something.
explanation.definitionFit: The dawn of something is its beginning or source, its starting point.

clue.text: Infuriating piece from outspoken rag in Germany

indicators.note: a piece taken from the word, here its final pair of letters

parts.note: the final two letters of outspoken
G is a standard abbreviation for German or Germany

explanation.surface: An outrageous article from a blunt German tabloid.
explanation.definitionFit: Enraging means making someone extremely angry, exasperating them.
